newsitem.title: CHINA: China '96 inflation seen near 7 pct --central bank.
newsitem.headline: China '96 inflation seen near 7 pct --central bank.

text.p: China's central bank governor Dai Xianglong has forecast annual inflation price for all of this year to be around seven percent, the Financial News said on Monday.
The newspaper quoted Dai as saying that the government's macro-economic control measures were showing signs of success.
Dai's remarks were said to have been made during a visit to the southwestern province of Yunnan late last month.
Inflation was 6.9 percent in the first seven months of 1996 and 5.9 percent in July alone, well below the government target of 10 percent for the entire year.
July inflation was down by more than one percentage point compared with June. The newspaper gave no further details.
China imposed an austerity programme three years ago to rein in surging prices, which hit a communist-era high of 21.7 percent in 1994.
